Adult Health Nursing Internship

Adult health nursing internship — 6 weeks of clinical practice in medical-surgical wards, ICU and emergency care.

🎯 After this chapter you can

  • Describe the objectives of the adult health internship
  • Plan care for medical and surgical patients
  • Practise critical and emergency care
  • Maintain nursing records and reports

In simple words

The adult health internship is six weeks of supervised clinical practice. It converts theory into safe, timely and competent patient care.

Objectives

  • Apply the nursing process to medical and surgical patients
  • Practise assessment, monitoring of vitals and comfort
  • Give medicines and intravenous therapy safely
  • Perform procedures: feeding, wound care, catheters, drains, oxygen therapy
  • Practise pre- and post-operative care
  • Take part in emergency and critical care
  • Communicate with patient, family and team
  • Maintain clinical records and participate in handover

Placement pattern

The student rotates through medical, surgical, ICU, casualty and specialty wards for six weeks. Each day begins with a handover, follows the daily plan, and ends with documentation of activities.

Skills to be performed

  • Vital signs, pain assessment, blood sugar
  • Medication administration by the five rights
  • Intravenous therapy, cannula, blood transfusion
  • Oxygen therapy, nebulisation, suction
  • Feeding: nasogastric tube, Ryles tube, care of the tube
  • Urinary catheter and ostomy care
  • Wound dressing, drain and sutures
  • Pre- and post-operative preparation and complication prevention
  • CPR support, triage and first aid

🔴 Supervision level by level

A student performs a procedure only after observing and practising in the skill lab, and always under supervision. Patient safety comes before the student’s learning.

🔴 Most important for exams

  1. Adult health internship covers medical, surgical, ICU and emergency care.
  2. Nursing process guides care for every patient.
  3. Medication by the five rights: right patient, drug, dose, route and time.
  4. Every activity must be documented.
  5. Students perform only what has been taught and supervised.

⭐ Important for exams

  1. Handover opens and closes each clinical day.
  2. Hand hygiene and infection control protect every patient.
  3. Patients have the right to refuse student care.
  4. Institute records must be complete and honest.
  5. Emergency training includes CPR and AED use.

📌 Memory trick

Safe practice: Supervised, Supervised, Supervised — always.

60-second revision

  • Apply nursing process to medical and surgical patients.
  • Practice analgesia, oxygen therapy, catheters, wounds and IV therapy.
  • Take part in emergency and ICU practice.
  • Communicate and document.
  • Perform only supervised taught skills.

Test yourself

The adult health internship usually lasts:

Answer: B. The adult health nursing internship is six weeks of supervised clinical practice.

Medication safety requires checking the five rights, which include:

Answer: B. The five rights are right patient, right drug, right dose, right route and right time.

A student may perform a procedure only after:

Answer: B. Skills must be practised and supervised in the skill lab before patient care.

Handover at the start of a shift mainly transfers:

Answer: A. Handover transfers key clinical information and care needs for safe continuity.

Which action breaches nursing ethics?

Answer: B. Falsifying or altering records is a serious offence and never acceptable.
